LazyMatrix is a Rust library for column normalization of design matrices. It
borrows the original matrix and applies fitted centers and scales during matrix
operations, avoiding a normalized copy and preserving sparse storage.

The library supports matrix-vector products, transpose products, weighted Gram
matrices, and an implicit intercept column. Backends include faer, nalgebra,
ndarray, sprs, and chunked Zarr arrays for matrices larger than memory. Fitted
normalization parameters can be reused on new observations.
